kind: per-player game log capture (dated attributed observations)
source_document_header: Injury Report: 11/17/26 10:30 AM (roster anchor) + five official NBA gamebooks: 2026-11-14 DET@MIA and 2026-11-15 LAL@PHX, CHA@LAC, SAS@UTA, NYK@TOR - each game-log row cites its own gamebook in source_url/source_label
extraction_tool: manual verbatim transcription from gamebook PDF chunk text; verified by scripts/build_gamelogs.py (mirror check against the injury file of record)
purpose: One dated, attributed observation row per player per game in the window, captured verbatim from the official gamebooks (played lines or the printed inactive/DND designation), covering every named player on the current injury file of record. These rows are evidence observations with row-level official links, NOT betting inputs: no projection, availability probability, minutes model or pick is derived from them (rights gate G0 and stances D-01/IR-T4 stand).

games_read_note: chunk 0 of each gamebook prints both teams' full-game box score and the inactive lists; every captured value comes from that chunk read on 2026-11-17. Window choice: Detroit's most recent game is 2026-11-14; the other six report teams last played on 2026-11-15; none of the 33 players' teams played on 2026-11-16 (the eight 11/16 finals carry no current-report team), so no 11/16 gamebook is needed.
extraction_notes: report_status/report_reason/report_team are mirrored from data/snapshots/injuries-2026-11-17-1030am.json by (report_block, report_name) join at build time and were re-verified against it row for row (33/33); they are the report's printed cells, not this file's observations.

Verbatim rule: a player with a game in the window appears either with a printed stat line (MIN/PTS/REB/AST as printed strings; REB is the printed TOT column, AST the printed A column) or with the printed designation (Inactive list entry, DNP - Coach's Decision, DND - ...). No value was computed or inferred.

Every row cites its own gamebook URL in source_url; game_id values were verified on the official nba.com games pages (lal-vs-phx-0022600237, cha-vs-lac-0022600238, sas-vs-uta-0022600239, nyk-vs-tor-0022600241 read 2026-11-17) and det-vs-mia-0022600233 from results-2026-11-14.json (official game page recorded there on 2026-11-15).

Name matching between the report's 'Last, First' print and the gamebook's 'First Last' print is by exact name tokens; suffixes (Jr., II) and diacritics are kept as printed on both sides. Designation spellings that differ from the report are kept as printed in designation_printed and are never merged into the mirrored report cells: the gamebook prints 'Schröder', 'Nurkić' and 'Niederhäuser' where the report prints 'Schroder', 'Nurkic' and 'Niederhauser', and the gamebook's Nurkić entry reads 'Right 2nd Plantar Plate Tear' where the report row reads 'Right Right Foot; 2nd Plantar Plate Tear'.

The Lakers inactive-list entry for Reaves wraps across a line break in the PDF text ('... Left Heel Contusion / Bone' / 'Bruise)'); the two fragments are joined with one space to reproduce the single printed entry. No other cell is altered.

One report row (Reaves, Austin, CHA@LAL) lost its team cell at a PDF page break; it keeps a blank team in the injury snapshot and here (report_team null + report_team_flag), with the observed team attributed from the gamebook's own team header (attribution_note). This does not repair the injury row.
No availability probability, minute estimate or production impact is stored here or derived from these rows.
